premises.text: Large buyers lack information on suppliers' environmental sustainability while consumers, shareholders, and media increasingly punish supply-chain scandals
premises.evidence_span: they don't have almost any information on their supplier's environmental sustainability

premises.text: SupplyShift is an integrated platform for understanding/managing supply-chain sustainability, evaluating risk, and driving suppliers to improve via scorecards and on-the-fly risk analysis
premises.evidence_span: the first truly integrated platform that helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk, and drive their suppliers to be better

premises.text: Suppliers see peer dashboards and buyers see anonymous outside-network scores, so better suppliers win more business and weak ones improve to keep buyers
premises.evidence_span: buyers have access to more sustainable suppliers, and more sustainable suppliers get more business

premises.text: Unified popular scorecard library cuts RFP fatigue so suppliers enter answers once instead of hiring staff for endless questionnaires
premises.evidence_span: we have a unified scorecard library that fixes the RFP fatigue problem

premises.text: Suppliers pay an annual fee plus a small per-supplier fee once enrolled
premises.evidence_span: once suppliers enroll, they pay a annual fee plus a small fee per supplier

value.text: Enterprises avoid environmental scandal headlines and choose the right suppliers for sustainable products
value.evidence_span: they'll know that they won't have to deal with environmental disaster headlines

causal_links.evidence_span: companies have very little information and are flying blind
supply chain risk analysis on the fly
more sustainable suppliers get more business
suppliers can then go on and innovate rather than respond to hundreds of questionnaires
pay a annual fee plus a small fee per supplier

notes: Consulting credentials excluded except as problem knowledge framing (§4.2.2). Questionnaire drill-down analytics and other feature list folded into platform mechanism (§4.1.7); peer/outside-network visibility and unified scorecard library split as separately argued value paths. GRI reporting growth treated as market timing framing. ASR SupplyShift/Supply ship variants left in spans. Five-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
